skills.description: This skill should be used when a user wants to replace image/video resources (PNG sequences, static PNGs) inside a PyInstaller single-file Windows executable (`.exe`) without re-running the original build. Triggers on requests like "把桌面宠物 exe 里的小狗视频换成猫" / "替换 PyInstaller exe 里的图片资源" / "swap the dog animation inside this exe with a cat" / "patch a single-file PyInstaller exe to use different assets".
